Praise the name of your Lord, the Highest.
He is the One who made everything and made it just right.
He is the One who planned everything and then showed the way.
He is the One who brings out the green grass.
And then makes it dark and dry.
We will help you read, and you will not forget.
Only what Allah wants. He knows what is open and what is hidden.
And We will make the way easy for you.
So remind people, if the reminder helps.
The one who fears Allah will listen to the reminder.
But the unhappy one will stay away from it.
He will go into the great Fire.
He will not die in it and will not live a good life.
The one who cleans his heart wins.
He remembers the name of his Lord and prays.
But you like the life of this world more.
While the next life is better and lasts longer.
This is in the earlier books.
The books of Ibrahim and Musa.
